body:
Device Information
	•	iPhone 12, iOS 18.6.1
	•	iPad 2019, iPadOS 18.7.2
	•	misaka26 version: 26.1.4
	•	macOS version: 15.7.2 (MacBook Pro, M1 Pro)

Bug Description
	•	Attempted to modify device model / enable Dynamic Island / Always-On Display (AOD)
	•	MobileGestalt file imported successfully, misaka26 Apply completes, device reboots
	•	After reboot, features are not applied (device model unchanged, Dynamic Island / AOD not working)
	•	No error messages are shown

Additional info: Both iPhone and iPad show the same behavior. iPad tested with “Foreground Scheduling” enabled.

Steps to Reproduce
	1.	Turn off or on Find My iPhone (as prompted)
	2.	Generate latest MobileGestalt file using Shortcut
	3.	Import file into misaka26 on macOS
	4.	Select features (Dynamic Island / AOD / device model change)
	5.	Click Apply → device automatically reboots
	6.	Check device model / feature status → features are not applied

⸻

Observed Behavior
	•	Device reboots after Apply
	•	No changes applied (device model unchanged, Dynamic Island / AOD not working)
	•	MobileGestalt file appears to not be written to the system

⸻

Expected Behavior
	•	After Apply and reboot, device model should update and Dynamic Island / AOD features should be active

⸻

Additional Information
	•	Both iPhone 12 and iPad 2019 exhibit this issue
	•	On iPad, enabling “Foreground Scheduling” also prevents features from applying
	•	File import / Apply does not report any errors
	•	Unsure if screenshots or videos are needed, but can provide if requested
